weight_note: The `weight` fields are INFORMATIONAL provenance only. harness_lib.serving_weighted_speedup ignores them and recomputes the primary metric from baseline_ms x analytic calls, giving each regime's whole call count to its largest-M bucket (prefill_M8192, decode_M64) and calls=1 to the rest.

profile_provenance.roofline: profile/round_0/profile_roofline.md: decode AI=6.3 FLOP/byte vs a 312 ridge -> memory side, but hbm_util=1.792 (>1) means the uniform-routing byte model is refuted by the measurement; roofline_pct is clamped to 1.000* and headroom is 'unknown'. Prefill was not modelled there: at 956.7 us/call it runs ~754 TFLOP/s, i.e. ~30% of the 2.5 PFLOP/s bf16 roof, so the prefill half is the compute-leaning one.
